name: yala-rider
description: Yala Rider - Book a Ride in Mauritania

scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item ../frontend/.env.rider ../frontend/.env.local -Force; Push-Location ../frontend; npm run build; Pop-Location; Remove-Item ./www -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item ../frontend/build ./www -Recurse -Force; node ../frontend/scripts/stamp-native-app-type.js rider ./www"
scripts.build:local: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item ../frontend/.env.rider.localtest ../frontend/.env.local -Force; Push-Location ../frontend; npm run build; Pop-Location; Remove-Item ./www -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item ../frontend/build ./www -Recurse -Force; node ../frontend/scripts/stamp-native-app-type.js rider ./www"
